# pearl-proxy

> 多币种矿池中转代理(Go 单二进制)。矿机 -> 本代理 -> 上游矿池。支持 stratum / ethproxy / cryptonote 三种方言,主备矿池切换,Web 面板与只读 JSON API。所有操作可非交互完成。

完整说明见 AGENTS.md。

## 快速命令
- 下载: https://github.com/Forlives/pearl-proxy-release/releases/latest (pearl-proxy-{linux-amd64,linux-arm64,windows-amd64.exe,darwin-amd64,darwin-arm64})
- 币种列表: `pearl-proxy -coins -json`
- 生成配置: `pearl-proxy -init -coin KAS -pool host:port [-backup h2:p2] [-listen 0.0.0.0:3333] [-dashboard-password X] [-api-token T] [-user-wallet W -user-fee 1] -config config.json`
- 校验: `pearl-proxy -check -json -config config.json` (exit 0 ok / 1 error)
- 启动: `pearl-proxy -config config.json`
- 版本: `pearl-proxy -version -json`

## HTTP
- GET /healthz (no auth) -> {ok, version, ports[{name,coin,pool_up}]}; 200 healthy / 503 pool unreachable
- GET /api/stats | /api/workers?limit&offset&q&port&state | /api/sessions?limit&offset&port | /api/pools | /api/alerts (Basic auth or Authorization: Bearer <dashboard.api_token>)
- GET /api/workers.csv, /api/sessions.csv
- POST /api/reload (Basic auth)
